We’re here to help. Visit All FAQs Page What is the difference between TheraNatal One and TheraNatal Complete? TheraNatal One contains only the most essential nutrients for pregnancy, including vitamin D 3 , methylated folate, iron, iodine, and DHA, in one easy-to-swallow softgel.* TheraNatal Complete is our most comprehensive prenatal in three pills per day. It includes the same nutrients as TheraNatal One, plus folic acid, extra vitamin B 6 to reduce pregnancy-related nausea, 250 mg of choline to support healthy brain development, and several other key nutrients for pregnancy.* How is TheraNatal One different from other prenatals? TheraNatal One is an essential prenatal, delivering the most important nutrients for you and your baby during pregnancy in one easy-to-swallow softgel: 75 mcg (3,000 IU) of vitamin D 3 to maintain healthy vitamin D levels during pregnancy* 220 mcg of iodine to promote thyroid hormone production* 27 mg of iron to support increased red blood cell production* 300 mg of DHA to support healthy brain development* Plus several other key nutrients during pregnancy* TheraNatal One also undergoes third-party testing for content accuracy, purity, and freedom from contaminants. Plus, our fish oil goes through additional testing and certification by the International Fish Oil Standards (IFOS™) program to ensure it’s free of mercury, PCBs, and other contaminants commonly found in fish oil. Can I start taking TheraNatal One before I am pregnant? Yes. While TheraNatal One is formulated to meet your needs during pregnancy, the nutrient doses in this prenatal are safe to take while you’re trying to conceive, too. Can I continue taking TheraNatal One after pregnancy? You can finish taking any remaining TheraNatal One after pregnancy. If you are planning to breastfeed, TheraNatal Lactation Complete is specifically formulated to meet your unique nutrients needs while breastfeeding. If you will be breastfeeding for at least several months, it is better to switch to TheraNatal Lactation Complete while breastfeeding instead of continuing with TheraNatal One. If you are NOT planning to breastfeed, we recommend transitioning to a women's multivitamin like Essentia once you finish taking TheraNatal One. What is the source of DHA in TheraNatal One? TheraNatal One contains 300 mg of DHA from AlaskOmega®, a highly purified omega-3 fish oil concentrate that’s sustainably sourced from wild-caught Alaska pollock from the Bering Sea and Gulf of Alaska. Every batch of fish oil in TheraNatal One is also tested and certified by the International Fish Oil Standards (IFOS™) program to ensure it’s free from harmful contaminants, including mercury, lead, and PCBs. It has continually received the highest rating of five stars from IFOS, which reflects its exceptional quality, purity, and safety. Can I take TheraNatal One if I’m allergic to fish? TheraNatal One contains omega-3 fish oil derived from wild-caught Alaska pollock. If you are allergic to fish, TheraNatal One may not be safe for you. Consult your allergist and/or healthcare team. Can I take TheraNatal One if I'm allergic to shellfish? TheraNatal One does not contain shellfish. If you have reacted to radiocontrast material or antiseptics that contain iodine, you may still be able to safely take TheraNatal One, even though it contains iodine. These reactions are commonly confused with a sensitivity to iodine or shellfish, though studies have shown that they are not related. Can I take other nutritional supplements along with TheraNatal One? Certain supplements can be taken along with TheraNatal One, including Ovasitol . However, we do not recommend taking another multivitamin or prenatal with TheraNatal One. Does TheraNatal One interact with any prescription medications? The list below includes some of the more common potential interactions. This is not meant to be a comprehensive list or take the place of advice from your healthcare provider. As with any dietary supplement, discuss with your pharmacist and/or healthcare team to determine whether TheraNatal One can be taken with your medications. Antibiotics: Taking iron (in TheraNatal One) with antibiotics can decrease their absorption and effectiveness. Depending on which antibiotic is prescribed, you may need to separate TheraNatal One from the antibiotic, as indicated below. Tetracycline antibiotics (doxycycline, minocycline, demeclocycline): Separate by 4 hours. Quinolone antibiotics (ciprofloxacin (Cipro), gemifloxacin (Factive), levofloxacin (Levaquin), moxifloxacin (Avelox)): Separate by 2 hours. Levodopa, Carbidopa: Taking iron (in TheraNatal One) might decrease the absorption of these medications. Take at separate times of the day. Oral Bisphosphonates (i.e., alendronate (Fosamax), etidronate (Didronel), risedronate (Actonel), ibandronate (Boniva), tiludronate (Skelid)): Iron (in TheraNatal One) can decrease the absorption of these medications. Separate by at least 2 hours. Penicillamine (Cuprimine, Depen): Iron (in TheraNatal One) may decrease the absorption of this medication. Separate by 2 hours. Thyroid hormone (levothyroxine, Synthroid): Minerals in TheraNatal One can decrease how much of the medication is absorbed. Separate TheraNatal One and thyroid hormone by at least 4 hours. Medications for overactive thyroid (methimazole, propylthiouracil): Iodine (in TheraNatal One) might change the effects of these medications. Consult with your healthcare provider if you’re taking medication for an overactive thyroid along with TheraNatal One. Is TheraNatal One FSA/HSA Eligible? Yes, all Theralogix products are FSA/HSA eligible. For one-time purchases, you can select Flex at checkout to pay with your FSA/HSA card.
